entities.summary: Tamaz Gelashvili (b. 1978-04-08, Georgian Soviet Socialist Republic) was a political leader or statesperson of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Georgian Soviet Socialist Republic and Georgia. Known in the fields of georgia, journalists & chroniclers, asia.
